capabilities: convert selected x86 assembly into a flow graph
generate Canvas files with nodes and edges from jump instructions
extras: Only works with a strict assembly format (indented instructions, unindented labels, one-argument jumps); generated nodes start mixed up and must be dragged into place manually. Author accepts donations via Buy Me a Coffee. Roadmap items pending, and the author says layout improvements are still being worked on.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to turn assembly code into a visual control-flow graph, so readers must trace jumps manually.
summary: Converts well-formatted x86 assembly code blocks into flow diagrams rendered as Obsidian Canvas files in the same directory as the note.
